script:
Su Shengce (Doctor)
Su Shengce is the town's doctor. His reputation isn't great, but many people come to him for treatment because there's only one clinic in town. Su Shengce knows that his medical skills aren't actually very good. Su Shengce keeps records of people who died under his treatment, using this to spur himself to excellence in medicine.
In the 30th year of the Sea Calendar, Su Shengce's small clinic had been established for about half a year when a man around 30 came. He was a merchant whose business was almost ruined because his warehouse was overrun with rats. He needed a large amount of rat poison, and it had to be potent. His small town clinic couldn't possibly have so much rat poison, but the merchant offered a high price, so Su Shengce gathered what he could and mixed in some sleeping pills to sell to him.
In the 35th year of the Sea Calendar, a person came to the clinic who looked and acted like someone from the martial world. He had an arrow in his chest. Su Shengce helped complete his treatment. During the examination, he found his symptoms very similar to a terminal illness that had killed many people at the time, so he told this person about having the terminal illness. But later, as his medical experience grew, he realized he had misdiagnosed, though it was fortunate - he didn't pay much attention to it.
But during a later visit to a martial arts arena for medical treatment, when he arrived at the scene, the injured person was already dead - it was exactly the person he had misdiagnosed. Su Shengce felt it was very likely that his misdiagnosis had caused this person to give up on life, and he felt very guilty.
In the 36th year of the Sea Calendar, Su Shengce had a child. That day, a familiar person came to the clinic - it was the merchant from that year. He said he had discovered an island full of gold mines and made a lot of money. His wife was giving birth after ten months of pregnancy, but Su Shengce made a mistake, causing both mother and child to die. Afraid the wealthy merchant would make him pay with his life, he replaced his own newborn child with the merchant's. When the merchant learned his wife had died, he wasn't as sad as expected. Moreover, the merchant wanted to invite Su Shengce to the island as his private physician. Thinking he could take care of his own child, Su Shengce agreed, letting his wife stay in their hometown while he went.
Su Shengce came to the island and learned the merchant was called Chu Wanhu, who had established Longevity Gate on the island. Chu Wanhu named "his" son Chu Chuan, then recruited steward Ma San and bodyguard Li Hao, and later married a young concubine Wang Tingting, who was very beautiful. Su Shengce has been working as a doctor on the island, responsible for all medical matters big and small. Over the years, he gradually became perfunctory in his work, often giving people random medicines when they came for treatment. In others' hearts, he still appeared as the lofty Divine Doctor Su, but only he knew he was actually Mediocre Doctor Su.
During this period, steward Ma San often came for treatment. Su Shengce could see that Ma San's symptoms were exactly the terminal illness, but having misdiagnosed someone before, he couldn't be too absolute. He prescribed some medicine and told him it was just a minor ailment that would be cured with medicine.
In the 50th year of the Sea Calendar, the merchant came. Chu Wanhu asked Su Shengce to prepare some medicines to make an elixir of immortality. Although Su Shengce didn't know how, he randomly selected several tonic medicines, refined them into a pill, and gave it to Chu Wanhu, telling him it could extend life.
In the 52nd year of the Sea Calendar, Chu Wanhu came to Su Shengce again, feeling unwell. After examining him for a long time without finding anything, he only felt something abnormal about his brain, so he randomly prescribed some brain disease medicine and told Chu Wanhu it was memory confusion syndrome, which might affect some past memories but wouldn't cause much harm to the present. From then on, Chu Wanhu became foolish and confused - whether because this result stimulated him or he really had memory disorders. After that, island affairs were gradually decided by Wang Tingting.
[55th Year of Sea Calendar, September 27th]
8 PM: That night, Su Shengce returned from outside and found someone at his door. That person noticed him and turned to stare at him - it was Li Hao, with strong killing intent in his eyes, frightening Su Shengce into kneeling directly on the ground. Then Li Hao asked him: "How did you kill my master back then?" Su Shengce didn't know what was happening. From Li Hao, he learned that the information came from steward Ma San: "The killer of his master was actually Chu Wanhu. Chu Wanhu knew some martial arts before but was far inferior to his master. However, poison was put in the tea on the day of the duel, and it was doctor Su Shengce who poisoned it." Su Shengce said it was absolutely Ma San framing him. Afraid Li Hao would kill Chu Wanhu and implicate his own son, he told Li Hao that Chu Chuan was his son.
8:30 PM: As usual, Su Shengce went to help the master take medicine to sleep. He came a bit late today - the room was already dark, so Su Shengce left.
Only Clue (Exposure -10 points): Chu Wanhu bought a large amount of rat poison back then.
acts_goal: Hide your identity as a mediocre doctor and make everyone believe you are the highly skilled Divine Doctor Su.
